rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the opening remarks of the press conference titled 菅内閣総理大臣記者会見 and dated 26 August 2011, 菅総理 said that, the three bills he had prioritised having passed, he would resign as leader of the Democratic Party that day and would resign the office of Prime Minister after a new party leader had been chosen (新代表が選出をされた後に総理大臣の職を辞することといたします).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the same remarks (【菅総理冒頭発言】) he said that he had taken up the office of Prime Minister on 8 June of the previous year (昨年の６月の８日に総理大臣の職に就いて以来).
